prior_finding.evidence: The new disk integration suite copies the production guard, changes only host telemetry and statfs readings in scratch copies, then launches that guard. The low-/ case requires RESOURCE_PREFLIGHT_REFUSED, RESOURCE_DISK_LOW, no admission, and no remaining heavy lease. The post-admission low-lease case requires RESOURCE_WATCH_UNSAFE with RESOURCE_DISK_LOW, owned workload termination, an unsafe hold, and an invalid final decision. Removing diskIsLow() from reasons() would defeat both expected guard outcomes.

evidence: sampleDiskSpace() independently samples the checkout, profile, actual lease root, and /. reasons() compares all four against the unchanged 20 GiB floor in both preflight and watchdog.

persistSafetyState() marks resourceInvalid and safetyStateBroken and sets exit 3 before throwing. Cleanup stops token-owned processes and retains the heavy lease when safetyStateBroken is true; the final journal verdict is invalid.

Hosted macOS CI run 37063114646 at head 7b0fedfa reports three process tests passed, zero failed, zero skipped across the safety-marker and disk-admission/watchdog steps. Earlier run 37062590809 failed before marker injection on CPU pressure; the new scratch fixture replaces non-disk telemetry only.
verdict_a_behavior.unverified: The original D54 browser acceptance has not been repeated with a valid terminal guard verdict. No actual physical low-disk or ENOSPC run was performed, and the local system volume remains about 2.9 GiB free, below the 20 GiB permit floor.

evidence: The decision tests retain the production preflight, reasons(), watchdog, ownership, and verdict paths; controlled inputs replace only external telemetry and filesystem measurements in a scratch copy.
The marker failure test starts a live owned child, makes its hold marker unwritable after admission, and asserts exit 3, invalid journal decision, retained lease, and child termination.

The two disk cases supply opposite decisions and distinct low-volume locations, so a hard-coded safe or low response cannot satisfy both; the new cases would fail if reasons() stopped calling diskIsLow().
verdict_b_quality.unverified: This reviewer did not run a planted mutation or local test because the host is below the resource floor; hosted CI proves green paths but does not itself execute the prescribed red mutation.

review_method: Fresh source and commit review, read-only hosted CI status, and read-only local disk/status inspection. No guard, test, build, browser, or release was launched locally.
